description: catalogue.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr: dams and flood defences datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about dams and flood defences; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Tronçons issus de la BD Topo du réseau des routes à grande circulation; Digue de protection contre les inondations et submersion et digue de c; Digue contre les inondations et submersion et digue de canaux et de ri; Propriétés grévées par l'exploitation des ouvrages hydrauliques - serv. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
